Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: its very bureaucratic, and not online.

questions.answer: an office for Erasmus student at campus

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: not that succesful, the system was for me really hard to understand, and i ended up taking classes i was not ready for. I think this is why my experience was not that good, because all of my classes was kind of hard, since the topics is not something that I am use to study.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Try to find the real course catalogues before you start, and plan you classes good, maybe that can help you getting the classes you hope for!
